Team —

Quick stage refresh on Orbital Health (Q3 pilot). They told me in the discovery call that procurement + security need final confirmations week of May 10. Current status:

- Demo complete (green)
- Security review outstanding (yellow) — they flagged SSO/KMS questions
- Procurement needs SOW/price confirmation (red)

I don’t want this to slip into next quarter. Suggested save-plan (short):
1) Marissa: lock in SOW version and the two pricing options by EOD Tue (attached version has our recommended edits).
2) Rishi: provide a short security summary (SSO/KMS + SOC2 references) and a named contact to handle their checklist by Wed.
3) Aditya: prepare a conservative commit forecast and a one-slide fallback (if procurement pushes pricing) for exec review.

Samir/Eva — looping you for transparency. If procurement needs alternate billing terms, please flag specifics in reply so we can prepare a red/amber/green path.

I’ve attached the latest SOW and a CSV with commit rows for this quarter.

Thanks —

Jasmine Liu

jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the clarity. A few points from our side:

- Procurement: SOW looks close but we need a Net 60 option and a data residency assurance written into §4.2. Procurement will not sign without those items.
- Security: SSO approach is fine but we need confirmation of KMS key custody and an estimated time-to-complete for SOC2 evidence (we are currently auditing vendors).
- Timing: Our legal lead is out 5/6–5/9; if we can get redlines by 5/10 we should be able to route for signature before month-end.

Can your team provide the two SOW variants (Net30 and Net60) and a short paragraph on KMS custody model by Monday 5/4? That will help us prioritize.

Samir

Jasmine/Marissa —

Quick security summary for procurement:
- SSO: Support SAML 2.0 — recommended implementation with IdP initiated flow. No open ports required.
- KMS: We offer a customer-managed KMS integration. Keys can be kept in the customer’s KMS (BYOK) — we never persist unencrypted key material. Docs: https://redwood.docs/kms-integration (internal).
- SOC2: Redwood holds SOC2 Type II reports; we can provide a redacted report and the auditor contact. Estimated turnaround to get evidence to their auditors: 7–10 business days once they request it formally.

Owner assignments:
- Security evidence packet: Rishi (will produce initial packet by 5/7).
- KMS integration checklist: Aditya (will provide one-pager for procurement by 5/5).

If procurement wants formal language to insert into the SOW about KMS custody, I can draft the short clause.

Rishi Malhotra
Security Solutions
redwood.security@redwood.ai

Thanks everyone — short status and next steps (save-plan summary):

Red items (must resolve to stay in this quarter):
- Procurement payment term + residency clause: Marissa — deliver Net60 SOW + clean redline to Samir by 5/06 EOD.
- Procurement sign-off timeline: Samir — confirm whether Net60 removes the procurement blocker; if not, advise next escalation path (legal exec contact) by EOD 5/06.

Yellow items (work in progress):
- Security evidence packet: Rishi — initial packet 5/07, final within 10 business days upon formal request.
- KMS clause: Rishi/Aditya — provide drafted clause and one-pager by 5/05.

Green items (done):
- Demo + product fit: complete.
- Exec alignment: internal exec sponsor confirmed (VP Product).

Meeting: I propose a brief sync on Fri 5/7 9:00am PT to confirm all items before routing to Legal. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Samir/Eva — appreciate the quick back-and-forth. If procurement wants alternate SOW language beyond Net60/residency, please list non-negotiables in reply so we can keep this in-quarter.

-Jasmine
